description:
We are a squad of Computer Science and AI students based in Singapore tackling the Lunar South Pole lighting and communications challenge. Our team brings strong hands-on experience in machine learning, Python data pipelines, quantitative modeling, and full-stack web development (React, Node.js, FastAPI, PyTorch).

We are building an intuitive, real-time lunar mission planning tool powered by real NASA ephemeris and topography datasets—turning complex orbital math into crisp, interactive visua
